planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and wiring pin D7 is used for the single DHT11 sensor.
Control period is set to 5 ms to allow model-side accumulation up to the required 5-second reporting cadence using elapsed_ms.
DHT validity is declared on the same physical pin as temperature; invalid reads hold last valid temperature in the device and validity is set false.
Serial reporting is gated by a model boolean trigger produced from elapsed_ms; the program appends only the numeric value for the typed channel (no fixed text messages were requested).
Assumption: the requirement only requests temperature; humidity is not sampled or reported.
